Name: Elliott Refined
Author: Chrysanthe
Description:
[b][size=5]Elliott Refined[/size][/b]
[color=#e06666]Updated for SDV ver 1.4 and now compatible with CP.[/color]

This is a refined version of Elliott's sprite which I felt looked awkward and out of place next to the other bachelors.
There are many tweaks including hair, face shape and outfit.

[u][Ver 1.1.0] Sprite Preview:[/u]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KD30lCe.gif[/img]       [img]http://i.imgur.com/jQGX5Rb.gif[/img]

[u]Before:[/u]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BfxEF8q.gif[/img]        [img]http://i.imgur.com/chbajCK.gif[/img]

I use my below portrait mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/938/?]Refined Bachelors Portraits[/url] with this sprite.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/yAOxavZ.png[/img]

[u][size=3][b]Instructions for SMAPI & CP:[/b][/size][/u]
. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url] and then [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
. Run the game using SMAPI.

[b][u][size=3]Instructions for [u][size=3].xnb (no SMAPI):[/size][/u]:[/size][/u][/b]
. This mod replaces the original Elliott.xnb sprite. Please make a backup of the original file if necessary.
. Unzip or extract the [i]Elliott.xnb[/i] file after downloading.
. Place the file into the Stardew Valley folder under [i][b]Content\Characters[/b][/i] and replace Elliott.xnb.

Thanks for downloading!
